desc: Implement coordinate compression for all $l_i$ and $r_i + 1$. Create a map `time_to_idx` and a sorted list of unique time points.
Iterate backwards through the unique time points. For each time point, identify all intervals starting at this time. Update `dp[k][idx]` using `dp[k-1][next_idx] + weight`.
Find the global maximum weight considering $k \in [1, 4]$.

Implement a recursive function `get_lexicographical_indices(k, start_time_idx)` that iterates $i$ from $0$ to $n-1$, checks the DP condition, and picks the first valid $i$ to minimize the index array.
Generate candidate solutions for all $k$ that achieve the global max weight and select the lexicographically smallest one.
Run the provided examples manually or mentally to verify correctness.
Check if the reconstruction logic correctly picks the lexicographically smallest indices when multiple sets of intervals yield the same maximum weight.
If any issues are found, fix them.
If all tests pass, mark as solved.
